protected_metadata: the roster rule reads object ids / shapes / sizes / heights, initial cells and the grid only (plan3d docstring); no roles, blockers, B/D labels, K-construction spec or outcomes; K is a reporting field

roster.rule: SHELF66V3_PLACE_ROSTER_V1 (plan3d.roster_for; production: every slot of every root, reference = False)

semantics.label 0: NEG_CERTIFIED_GEOMETRY (scope: 32 poses x <= 4 source IK candidates x the 2-D footprint carry model) or NEG_UNDER_POLICY (BOUNDED_SEARCH / EXECUTION / DETERMINISTIC_PLAN under adaptive_v1, with its scope record)
semantics.label 1: VERIFIED: a stored witness passes every gate (re-verified by fresh-process replay)
semantics.label None: UNLABELED_NO_VALID_POST_GRASP_STATE / UNLABELED_SCENE_NOT_SETTLED / INTERRUPTED: never a negative
semantics.physical query: V_place(S_hyp, o, d) conditional on a certified post-grasp hold: already held -> lift -> carry -> lower -> release -> retreat -> settle (13 MuJoCo gates); not pick accessibility, not target-task success
semantics.static contrast: OCCUPIED / OUT_OF_BOUNDS destinations: static ineligible rows, never sent to the physical teacher, kept apart from learned negatives
